title: LeanCTX Team Context Common Types v1
description: Shared type library for team-context-v1. This file defines no record; it is referenced by every record schema. Digest definitions are distinguished by preimage class; see README 'Digest and preimage table'.

id.description: Untyped tenant-scoped identifier. Colons are excluded so an untyped id can never collide with a typed namespace such as 'member:' or 'key:'.

memberId.description: Typed member namespace. Disjoint from $defs/id and from every other typed namespace.

keyId.description: Typed signing-key namespace. Disjoint from $defs/id and $defs/memberId.

timestamp.description: Canonical UTC RFC 3339 instant. The pattern is asserted because 'format' is annotation-only under the 2020-12 default vocabulary. Only the 'Z' designator is admitted: a numeric offset denotes the same instant but different JCS bytes and therefore a different record digest.

sha256Digest.description: Grammar only: lowercase 'sha256:' followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Never reference this definition directly from a record; reference the preimage-specific definition instead.

hmacSha256Digest.description: Grammar only: lowercase 'hmac-sha256:' followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The distinct prefix makes an unsalted SHA-256 of an identifier structurally unrepresentable where a pseudonym is required.

recordDigest.description: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS canonical bytes of a complete, validated team-context-v1 record.

contentDigest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical bytes of a referenced payload that is not itself a team-context-v1 record (context content, policy rule document, source descriptor). JCS applies when the payload is JSON; otherwise the raw octet stream is hashed.

canonicalBytesDigest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 JCS canonical bytes of an operation's request or response body, as admitted by the server after the request-body limit.

nonceDigest.description: SHA-256 over a single-use nonce whose preimage is at least 128 bits from a CSPRNG. The preimage is never stored, logged or returned.

pseudonymDigest.description: HMAC-SHA-256(per-tenant pepper, NFC(lowercase(subject identifier))). The pepper is at least 256 bits from a CSPRNG, is unique per organization, is stored outside the record store and is never emitted. Pepper rotation is a versioned policy decision that rewrites the derived pseudonyms.

reasonCode.description: Bounded enumerable reason token. Free text, paths, prompts and secrets are forbidden.

version.description: Monotonic per-record CAS version. Version 1 is the genesis record and carries no parent_digest; every version above 1 carries the record digest of its immediate predecessor.

authorityState.description: Authority lifecycle of a shared context object. Used wherever object authority is meant; a checkpoint uses $defs/checkpointState instead.

checkpointState.description: Lifecycle of a workspace checkpoint manifest. Deliberately disjoint from $defs/authorityState so a checkpoint state can never be mistaken for object authority.

action.description: Single shared action vocabulary. $defs/action is both the unit of authorization granted by workspace-role.allowed_actions and the operation_kind recorded by team-receipt, so every receipt-bearing operation is grantable and every grantable action is receipt-bearing.

casLineage.description: Genesis and compare-and-swap lineage rule, applied via allOf by every mutable record. version = 1 is the genesis record and MUST NOT carry parent_digest; version > 1 MUST carry the record digest of its immediate predecessor. No sentinel digest exists, so cross-implementation digest determinism is preserved.
